C1706.title: Unsolicited Shared Files Appearing in OneDrive Account
C1706.summary: Since December 2025, a user's OneDrive account has been receiving multiple unsolicited PDF files from unknown sources. Attempts to report these files through OneDrive's built-in reporting tool consistently failed with errors, preventing the user from flagging or removing the content through normal channels.
